arxiv-1704-02333.title: The leptonic future of the Higgs
arxiv-1704-02333.creator: Gauthier Durieux,
arxiv-1704-02333.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Gauthier Durieux,. Precision study of electroweak symmetry breaking strongly motivates the construction of a lepton collider with center-of-mass energy of at least 240 240 GeV. Besides Higgsstrahlung ( e + ​ e − → h ​ Z e^{+}e^{-}\to hZ ), such a collider would measure weak boson pair production ( e + ​ e − → W ​ W e^{+}e^{-}\to WW ) with an astonishing precision.

arxiv-2007-05694.title: Long-Term Planning with Deep Reinforcement Learning on Autonomous Drones
arxiv-2007-05694.creator: Ugurkan Ates
arxiv-2007-05694.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a long-term planning scenario that is based on drone racing competitions held in real life. We conducted this experiment on a framework created for "Game of Drones: Drone Racing Competition" at NeurIPS 2019. The racing environment was created using Microsoft’s AirSim Drone Racing Lab.

arxiv-2110-03459.title: Graph sampling by lagged random walk
arxiv-2110-03459.creator: Li-Chun Zhang
arxiv-2110-03459.description: Abstract We propose a family of lagged random walk sampling methods in simple undirected graphs, where transition to the next state (i.e. node) depends on both the current and previous states—hence, lagged. The existing random walk sampling methods can be incorporated as special cases.

arxiv-2209-09229.title: Derivatives of L L -series of weakly holomorphic cusp forms
arxiv-2209-09229.creator: Nikolaos Diamantis, Fredrik Strömberg
arxiv-2209-09229.description: Abstract . Based on the theory of L L -series associated with weakly holomorphic modular forms in [ 11 ] , we derive explicit formulas for central values of derivatives of L L -series as integrals with limits inside the upper half-plane.

arxiv-2305-07011.title: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers
arxiv-2305-07011.creator: Dahun Kim, Anelia Angelova, Weicheng Kuo
arxiv-2305-07011.description: Abstract We present Region-aware Open-vocabulary Vision Transformers (RO-ViT) – a contrastive image-text pretraining recipe to bridge the gap between image-level pretraining and open-vocabulary object detection. At the pretraining phase, we propose to randomly crop and resize regions of positional embeddings instead of using the whole image positional embeddings.

arxiv-2309-16080.title: Magnetocaloric effect in Cu 3 \mathrm{Cu}_{3} -type compounds using the Heisenberg antiferromagnetic model in a triangular ring
arxiv-2309-16080.creator: G. A. Antonio, J. Torrico, A. S. da Mata, S. M. de Souza, Onofre Rojas
arxiv-2309-16080.description: Abstract In this work we present a theoretical investigation into an antiferromagnetically coupled spin system, specifically Cu 3 − X {\rm Cu}_{3}-X ( X = As , Sb \mathrm{X=As,Sb} ), which exhibits an isosceles triangular configuration or slightly distorted equilateral triangular configuration, as previously identified in reference [Phys. Rev. Lett. 96 , 107202 (2006)].

arxiv-2411-13186.title: VADet: Multi-frame LiDAR 3D Object Detection using Variable Aggregation
arxiv-2411-13186.creator: Chengjie Huang, Vahdat Abdelzad, Sean Sedwards, Krzysztof Czarnecki
arxiv-2411-13186.description: Abstract Input aggregation is a simple technique used by state-of-the-art LiDAR 3D object detectors to improve detection. However, increasing aggregation is known to have diminishing returns and even performance degradation, due to objects responding differently to the number of aggregated frames. To address this limitation, we propose an efficient adaptive method, which we call Variable Aggregation Detection (VADet).

arxiv-2501-00720.title: Realistic overground gait transitions are not sharp but involve gradually changing walk-run mixtures as per energy optimality
arxiv-2501-00720.creator: Nicholas S. Baker, Leroy Long, Manoj Srinivasan
arxiv-2501-00720.description: Abstract Humans use two qualitatively different gaits for locomotion, namely, walking and running — usually using walking at lower speeds and running at higher speeds. Researchers have examined when humans switch between walking and running on treadmills and have noted hystereses in these gait transition speeds.

arxiv-2507-09686.title: Quantum Singular Value Transformation for Solving the Time-Dependent Maxwell’s Equations
arxiv-2507-09686.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . This work presents a quantum algorithm for solving linear systems of equations of the form 𝐀 ​ ∂ 𝐟 ∂ 𝐱 = 𝐁𝐟 \mathbf{A}{\frac{\mathbf{\partial f}}{\mathbf{\partial x}}}=\mathbf{B}\mathbf{f} , based on the Quantum Singular Value Transformation (QSVT).

arxiv-2507-18859.title: Quantum diffusion in the Harper model under polychromatic time-perturbation
arxiv-2507-18859.creator: Hiroaki S. Yamada, Kensuke S. Ikeda
arxiv-2507-18859.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Hiroaki S. Yamada, Kensuke S. Ikeda. Quantum dynamics of the Harper model with self-duality exhibits localized, diffusive, and ballistic states depending on the potential strength V V . By adding time-dependent harmonic perturbations composed of M M incommensurate frequencies, we show that all states of the Harper model transition to quantum diffusive states as the perturbation strength ϵ \epsilon increases for M ≥ 3 M\geq 3 .

arxiv-2512-18800.title: A Segmented Heater-Driven, Low-Loss, Reconfigurable Photonic Phase-Change Material-Based Phase Shifter
arxiv-2512-18800.creator: Ranjeet Dwivedi, Agraj Yadav, Regis Orobtchouk, Benoit Charbonnier, Stephane Malhouitre, Pierre Noé, Fabio Pavanello
arxiv-2512-18800.description: Abstract Phase-change material (PCM)-based non-volatile multilevel phase shifters are key components in photonic integrated circuits. Electrically, multiple phase levels can be encoded by controlling the heater power and employing different microheater architectures to induce varying degrees of PCM amorphization. However, encoding a large number of levels is not straightforward.

britannica-1911-cremation.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cremation.description: Article 'Cremation' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 7), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. been the general practice of the ancient world, with the important exceptions of Egypt, where bodies were embalmed, Judaea, where they were buried in sepulchres, and China, where they were buried in the earth. In Greece, for instance, so well ascertained was the law that only suicides, unteethed children, and persons struck by lightning were denied the right to be burned.

britannica-1911-tapeworms.title: Tapeworms (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tapeworms.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tapeworms.description: Article 'Tapeworms' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. of purely endoparasitic Platyelmia, characterized by their elongate shape, segmented bodies, and the absence of a digestive system. With few exceptions they are composed (1) of a minute organ of fixation (the scolex), which marks the proximal attached end of the body; (2) of a narrow neck from which (3) a number of segments varying from three to several thousands are budded off distally.

pmc-11332848.title: Proposal for a grading system to determine the clinical status and sequence of permanent teeth eruption: A pilot study
pmc-11332848.creator: S Vandana, MS Muthu, D Kandaswamy, MB Aswath Narayanan
pmc-11332848.description: ObjectivesThe objective of the study was to propose and test a new grading system to quantify the clinical eruption of teeth into the oral cavity. In addition, the study also aimed to apply the grading system to a sample population to determine the chronology and sequence of permanent tooth eruptions, comparing the results with an existing standard table.

pmc-11344607.title: The Impact of Tranexamic Acid on Blood Loss Management in Primary Total Knee Arthroplasty: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-11344607.creator: Sharad Sawant, Sanjay V Deshpande, Hitendra Wamborikar, Vivek H Jadawala, Anmol Suneja, Sachin Goel, Vatsal Patel
pmc-11344607.description: Total knee arthroplasty (TKA) is a widely performed surgical procedure to restore function and relieve pain in patients with advanced knee arthritis. One of the key challenges in TKA is managing perioperative blood loss, which can lead to complications such as postoperative anemia and the need for blood transfusions.

pmc-11711371.title: Exploring the Prevalence and Prognostic Impact of Wilms Tumor 1 Exon 7 Mutation Status with Combinations of FLT3-ITD and NPM1 Mutations as Potential Molecular Biomarkers in Acute Myeloid Leukemia Patients with Normal Cytogenetics
pmc-11711371.creator: Geetha Raj John Anitha, Vineetha Radhakrishnan Chandraprabha, Devipriya Padmakumar, Mahitha Mohanan Sreelatha, Amritha Padmakumar, Preethi Gopinath, Akhila Raj Thampirajan Vimala Devi, Suraj Lathika Surendran, Geetha Narayanan, Hariharan Sreedharan, Jagathnath Krishna Kumarapillai Mohanan Nair
pmc-11711371.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Aim:This study explores the prognostic impact of FLT3-ITD, NPM1, and WT1 mutations both independently and in combination in Cytogenetically Normal Acute Myeloid Leukemia (CN-AML) patients as they exhibit varying clinical outcomes. Methods: 150 CN-AML patients were selected to assess the prevalence and prognostic significance of WT1 mutations in combination with FLT3-ITD and NPM1 status using polymerase chain reaction (PCR) followed by Sanger sequencing. Results: WT1 exon 7 mutations were present in 12.6% of patients.

pmc-11863018.title: Development and Validation of the Isotretinoin Hesitancy Scale
pmc-11863018.creator: E. Agaoglu, I. G. Yilmaz-Karaman, C. Yastibas-Kacar, H. Kaya-Erdogan, T. Mutlu, E. Acer
pmc-11863018.description: IntroductionIsotretinoin is an effective treatment for acne vulgaris; however, many patients experience anxiety while deciding to get it. Isotretinoin, indeed, has significant adverse effects. On the other hand, effective treatment of acne vulgaris may reduce dermatological and psychiatric complications.ObjectivesThe present study aims to develop and validate the Isotretionin Hesitancy Scale to measure the patients’ drawbacks to the treatment.

pmc-12619681.title: Outcomes and Complications of Brainstem Arteriovenous Malformation (AVM) Embolization: A Systematic Review
pmc-12619681.creator: Ali K. Al-Shalchy, Nooruldeen H. Ali Al-Khafaji, Abdullah K. Alqaraghuli, Mohammed Bani Saad
pmc-12619681.description: Brainstem arteriovenous malformations (AVMs) are rare, high-risk lesions with controversial endovascular management. We systematically reviewed the literature to clarify obliteration rates, complications, and mortality related to embolization of intrinsic brainstem AVMs and to situate the technique within modern multimodal care.

pmc-13328892.title: Impact of the simulation-based Airway and Catheter Cannulation Education—from Starters to Specialists (ACCESS) program for critical care procedures
pmc-13328892.creator: Jung Rae Cho, Hancheol Jo, Yoonjung Heo, Dong Hun Kim
pmc-13328892.description: PurposeCentral venous catheterization and endotracheal intubation are critical lifesaving procedures, yet structured training opportunities remain limited and often rely on informal apprenticeships. This study evaluates the effectiveness of the Airway and Catheter Cannulation Education—from Starters to Specialists (ACCESS) program in improving procedural knowledge, confidence, and ultrasound proficiency.

pmc-13386852.title: STUB1-mediated ubiquitination regulates Fli-1 stability and CD4⁺T cell activation during inflammation
pmc-13386852.creator: Pengfei Li, Liu Liu, Yan Wu, Meng Liu, Maria Trojanowska, Hongkuan Fan
pmc-13386852.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundFli-1, a member of the ETS transcription factor family, has been implicated in multiple inflammatory and immune-related disorders, including sepsis, lupus, Alzheimer’s disease, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). Recent studies further suggest a critical role for Fli-1 in CD4⁺ T cells in graft-versus-host disease, systemic sclerosis, and PTSD; however, its precise function and regulation during inflammatory CD4⁺ T cell responses remain incompletely understood.MethodsWild-type and CD4⁺ T cell–specific Fli-1 knockout mice were administered LPS via intraperitoneal injection.
